claims.text: Avranc tried to shoot Manthor twice, but missed. Avranc escaped the burning of the Hall, but Hardang was slain. Avranc managed to shoot Manthor two days later, but a new wave of rioting upon Amon Obel followed. In the end, Avranc was chosen as the new Halad, and the descendants of Haldad were no more. The people perceived that it was Húrin who brought the ruin on Brethil. The counsels of Hardang "were more wise", but Avranc wielded no such authority or reverence as the Haladin before. Many men forsook Brethil.

claims.text:
In the draft manuscript Avranc's name was Forhend. In the typescript this was changed to Farang, then Faranc, and finally Avranc.
In a later note, the name of Avranc was changed to Daruin.
